concerns.text: The plan applies a Durbin‑Watson test to FTLE time‑series within a single trajectory and, if autocorrelation is detected, switches to Newey‑West HAC standard errors for the mixed‑effects regression across trials. Newey‑West correction is designed for serial correlation in a single time‑series, not for hierarchical data where observations are (approximately) independent across trajectories and windows. This mismatch may lead to inappropriate standard‑error estimates. Consider using cluster‑robust SEs or explicitly modelling autocorrelation within the mixed‑effects framework instead of Newey‑West.
